statement: No finite integer-order regularized Fredholm determinant of the prime-diagonal heat family det_k(I-exp(-sH)), H e_p=(log p)e_p, has zeros in its open Schatten half-plane Re s>1/k.
hypotheses: Hilbert space ell^2 of primes; k a positive integer; standard regularized Fredholm determinant.
definitions: H maximal real multiplication by log p; A_s=exp(-sH); det_k subtracts the first k-1 logarithmic power terms.
proof_or_gap: H self-adjoint on weighted domain; A_s in S_k iff k Re s>1. Its norm <1. Log det_k equals a locally normally convergent negative prime-power tail. Hence det_k and its reciprocal are holomorphic nonvanishing. Adjacent orders differ by the exponential of the kth trace over their common domain.
implication_to_claim: Rules out direct Schatten regularization of this noncircular prime family as the all-zero identity (including k>=3 across the critical line). Does not exclude other operator constructions.
unproved_dependencies: A different arithmetic operator with a noncircular complete zero-divisor identity or independently justified global Weil positivity; multiplicities and domains.
adversarial_findings: A prime-based self-adjoint H and a regularized determinant in the strip are insufficient: the determinant cannot carry the zero divisor. Missing scalar counterterms cannot be assumed zero-free on continuation.
